args.summary: After the v2.3.1 deployment, checkout-api failed health checks in production. First attempted rollback to v2.3.0 (last healthy release) but it was rejected because v2.3.0 is quarantined (CVE-2026-4417). Rolled back to v2.2.9 (the most recent non-quarantined healthy release) in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rollback verified: service healthy, error rate 0.002.
args.title: checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.2.9

trace.final:
Done. Summary:

1. **Investigated deployments**: The latest production deploy `v2.3.1` was unhealthy; the most recent healthy production release was `v2.3.0`.
2. **Rollback attempt**: Rollback to `v2.3.0` was rejected — that version is quarantined due to **CVE-2026-4417**.
3. **Executed rollback to `v2.2.9`** (the most recent healthy, non-quarantined release) across all production regions: `us-east`, `us-west`, `eu-west`.
4. **Verified health**: checkout-api is now healthy on `v2.2.9` in all regions with an error rate of 0.002.
5. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** (on-call paged) documenting the health check failures, the quarantined-version rejection, and the successful rollback.

Follow-up worth noting: `v2.3.0` is quarantined for a CVE, so `v2.2.9` is running despite also being older — a patched version should be deployed once remediation is available.
